question: 各品类商品库存有多少
gold_sql: select c.category_name, sum(p.stock) from products p join categories c on p.category_id = c.category_id group by c.category_name
raw_output:
SELECT c.category_name, COALESCE(SUM(p.stock), 0) AS total_stock
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY total_stock DESC;
pred_sql:
